title: Register for community services portable long service leave
what: Apply for registration on the employers register within 1 month of becoming an employer in the community sector industry, then lodge returns and pay the levy.

sources.title: Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 31(1) (current republication (R30, from 26 November 2025; Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 | Acts))
sources.quote: An employer for a covered industry must apply to the registrar for registration on the employers register not later than— (a) 1 month after becoming an employer for the industry; or (b) the end of any additional time the registrar allows

sources.title: Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes) Act 2009 (ACT)
sources.locator: dict, def authority, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current republication (R30, from 26 November 2025; Long Service Leave (Portable Schemes)
sources.quote: authority means the Long Service Leave Authority established under section 79A.
